g.text: Real guards, one tablet per post
More sites, one at a time
audit trail that never overwrites (11.10 e)
signer, time and meaning on every signature (11.50)
lockouts reported to the supervisor (11.300 d)
a real secret instead of date of birth (11.200, 11.300 b)
hash sealed with a key DBAs do not hold (11.70)
validation plan, training, written policies (11.10 a, i, j)
FDA certification letter if ever regulated (11.100 c)
